maxDrawdown.details: Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) is end-of-day trailing on all Alpha Futures accounts; recalculated daily from the highest EOD balance. Trailing stops permanently once the MLL reaches the initial starting balance, then becomes static. Same mechanics on evaluation and qualified accounts. MLL stays intact after withdrawals (no 'MLL slides to $0 at first payout' rule).

consistencyRule.details: No consistency rule during the Zero evaluation ('one day pass' possible). 40% consistency on Zero Qualified accounts: profits from any single trading day cannot be >= 40% of net profits accumulated since last withdrawal request. No overnight/weekend holding: all trades must be closed before 4:20PM ET every day (futures day runs 6PM–5PM ET); markets flat Friday 5PM ET to Sunday 6PM ET. No bots/HFT (>100 trades/day), no tick scalping (<10 ticks and <2 min), no hedging/reverse trading, no VPN.

firms.generalNotes: Official domain is alpha-futures.com (help center: help.alpha-futures.com). Current lineup as of 2026-07-27: Zero (25K/50K/100K), Advanced (50K/100K/150K), and Direct instant-funded (25K/50K/100K/150K). The legacy Standard plan was RETIRED as of May 1, 2026 (existing accounts grandfathered; it had $149 activation, 50%-eval/40%-qualified consistency, and a 70/80/90 tiered split), and the Premium plan was discontinued in July 2026. Activation fees are $0 firm-wide for accounts purchased after the July 8, 2026 announcement (Advanced previously $149; Zero always $0). All accounts use an end-of-day trailing Maximum Loss Limit that trails the highest EOD balance and permanently stops trailing (goes static) once it reaches the initial starting balance. Daily Loss Guard (2% of starting balance) is a mandatory soft breach on Zero and Direct accounts — hitting it flattens and locks the account until 6PM ET without failing it; Advanced has none (optional self-set). Tradable products: CME/CBOT/NYMEX/COMEX futures plus MBT/MET crypto micros (counted as minis). Day-trading only: all positions must be closed before 4:20PM ET every day (trading day 6PM–5PM ET) and no weekend holding (Fri 5PM–Sun 6PM ET). Prohibited: automation/bots, HFT (>100 trades/day), tick/micro scalping (<10 ticks and <2 minutes), pattern scalping, order-book spamming, gap trading, reverse trading/hedging, group/copy coordination, VPN use (VPS allowed). Max allocation: up to 5 Zero Qualified accounts. Qualified-account reset prices per homepage: Zero $399/$499/$799 (25K/50K/100K). Evaluation minimum trading days: Zero has none (one-day pass possible; recorded as 1), Advanced requires 3.
firms.payoutPolicy: 90% profit split on all current plans from the first payout, up to 4 payouts per month, and each request may be up to 50% of accrued profits (remainder stays for future requests). Zero/Advanced: eligible after every 5 winning days of $200+ profit; Zero min $200 with caps $1,000/$1,500/$2,500 by size and a 40% consistency gate; Advanced min $1,000, max $15,000, no consistency gate and no cap by size. Direct: no winning-day requirement — eligible when the Withdrawal Profit Target (first vs subsequent) and 20% consistency gate are met; min $500 with caps $1,000–$3,000 by size. Failing a consistency gate never breaches the account; it only delays payout eligibility, and the gate resets with each withdrawal request. There is no separate buffer/threshold rule: the MLL stays intact after a withdrawal (it does not jump to the starting balance or $0 upon payout). Sources: https://help.alpha-futures.com/en/articles/9492051-payout-policy, https://help.alpha-futures.com/en/articles/9492048-consistency-rule, https://help.alpha-futures.com/en/articles/11771813-zero-account-overview, https://help.alpha-futures.com/en/articles/11634907-advanced-account-overview, https://help.alpha-futures.com/en/articles/15838742-direct-account-overview
